endpoint_eligibility.accessibility_delta: eligible as a secondary assay-native endpoint after local training and fixed sign fixtures
endpoint_eligibility.allelic_direction_accuracy: eligible for locus-cross-fitted GSE281364 reporter direction and other assay-native diagnostics; not equivalent to eQTL direction
endpoint_eligibility.eqtl_retrieval_auprc: eligible only as a variant-prior component after a separately frozen variant-to-gene mapper
endpoint_eligibility.mean_fisher_z_celltype_spearman: ineligible standalone because deltaSVM supplies neither a target gene nor a signed cell-type expression effect
endpoint_eligibility.typed_evidence_graph: activity-delta evidence edge only; never an enhancer-to-gene or causal edge

current_coloc_gwas.allowed_use: Development-only retrieval/error audit after the corrected graph snapshot is frozen. COLOC memberships cannot train the LS-GKM classifier, select peak backgrounds, set a delta threshold, or assign a gene direction.

gse244832.allowed_use: Donor-compatible external-development accessibility diagnostics only. RNA and ATAC arise from different aliquots; no cell-level pair or RNA-conditioned delta is created. No GSE244832 row or peak may enter a model scored on this source.

gse281160.allowed_use: Development-only direction diagnostic for the 20 MPRA-selected noncoding targets. Experimental replicate is the unit; cells and guides are not biological replicates. The conditional target set cannot select models or support a general superiority claim.

gse281364.allowed_use: Fit or assess only an assay-native MPRA activity/direction transform out of fold by merged locus, exact sequence, and reverse-complement identity. Replicate libraries are not donors. This source cannot fit an eQTL/ieQTL effect head.

gse289173.allowed_use: One-time SNP sequence inference with the selection-locked project model. Only evaluator-approved coordinates and alleles enter the sequence builder. No cell-state QTL effect, retrieval label, threshold, calibration, or target-gene outcome enters fitting.

gse296875.allowed_use: Outer-training donor-by-cell-state ATAC supplies local peak versus matched-nonpeak labels. Peak calling, accessibility summaries, matching, duplicate grouping, and every LS-GKM artifact remain inside crossed donor and genomic folds.

local_model_roster.donor_pooling: Pseudobulk fragments within donor and cell state for QC, then pool only outer-training donors to call each training peak universe. Donor is the inferential unit.
local_model_roster.genomic_split: Cross outer donor folds with native-build merged LD/locus blocks. A 300-bp model boundary buffer is the minimum; use the campaign-wide larger buffer when another compared model requires it.
local_model_roster.state_absence: If a canonical state cannot be resolved or passes insufficient QC, mark it structurally_missing. Do not substitute the nearest cell state.

reference_topology_and_missingness.gse244832: Distinct RNA and ATAC aliquot row IDs; donor-by-cell-state comparison only.
reference_topology_and_missingness.gse281160: Same-cell guide and RNA observations aggregate first to experimental replicate and target family.
reference_topology_and_missingness.gse281364: DNA and RNA barcode counts are same-sample different aliquots; a missing oligo/allele/context join is not zero activity.
reference_topology_and_missingness.gse289173: RNA and QTL summaries are same-study unpaired. The model consumes sequence only and emits no donor-conditioned prediction.
reference_topology_and_missingness.gse296875: Same-nucleus provenance is retained, but LS-GKM consumes training-fold donor-state ATAC peak labels rather than individual nuclei.
reference_topology_and_missingness.missingness: Missing peaks, failed REF matches, absent states, untestable variants, and withheld outcomes use explicit states and are never encoded as zero.

split_and_leakage_rules.donors: All nuclei and wells from one person remain in one outer fold; well is a technical batch, not a replicate.
split_and_leakage_rules.genomics: Merge native-build LD r2>=0.8 blocks, loci within 1 Mb, exact sequence identities, and reverse-complement identities before splitting. Neither positives nor matched negatives may cross a held block or buffer.
split_and_leakage_rules.preprocessing: Fit ATAC QC, peak calls, accessibility deciles, matching pools, sequence filters, k-mer tables, any MPRA transform, and thresholds inside the applicable outer-training partition.
split_and_leakage_rules.sealed_rule: After selection, refit the named local model on all admitted development data, hash model and k-mer tables, lock signs and thresholds, then score anonymized sealed variants once.

relationship_to_gkmsvm.shared_weights: Use identical model artifact IDs and hashes in both adapters.
relationship_to_gkmsvm.distinct_outputs: gkmsvm reports full-window raw decision scores and ALT-minus-REF decision deltas; deltaSVM reports the published local overlapping-k-mer proxy-weight sum in native REF-minus-ALT orientation.
relationship_to_gkmsvm.statistical_rule: Do not count both outputs as independent models, evidence sources, or biological replicates.
